info.title: Mechbase API
info.description: API for pushing measurements and managing industrial assets.

put.description: Idempotent upsert by external_id: 201 when created, 200 when updated. Requires external_id + name.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the section has zones or assets, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

post.description: Requires a parent section (section_id or section_external_id).

put.description: Idempotent PUT on the collection, keyed on external_id; requires a parent section and a name.

patch.description: Re-parenting a zone to another section is not allowed; delete and recreate instead.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the zone has assets, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

post.description: Requires a parent section (section_id or section_external_id). Zone optional, within that section.

put.description: Idempotent upsert by external_id; needs a parent section + name. Section immutable across upserts.

patch.description: Section is immutable. Zone can change within the section, or be cleared with zone_id=null.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the asset has measurement points, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

post.description: Requires a parent asset (asset_id or asset_external_id). PR points are auto-managed.

put.summary: Create-or-update a measurement point by external_id (upsert)
put.description: Idempotent upsert by external_id; needs a parent asset (immutable). Name auto-composed if omitted.

patch.description: The parent asset is immutable; delete and recreate to move a point.

delete.description: Refuses with 409 when the point has recorded measurements, unless ?cascade=true is passed.

get.summary: Legacy v1 URL → v2 MP map (for offline QR-code resolution)
get.description:
Return the full legacy-URL → v2 MP mapping for one installation.

Mobile clients fetch this once, cache it locally, and use it to resolve
old QR codes (encoded with v1 ``/plantlayer/<uuid>/`` or
``/measurementpoint/<uuid>/`` URLs) to the matching v2 measurement-point
detail page even when offline.

post.description: Record a measurement for a point (referenced by measurement_point_id or measurement_point_external_id). Optional fields: notes/session_id/timestamp. Pass external_id to make the write idempotent: a retried push with the same external_id returns the existing reading (200) instead of creating a duplicate (201). A 409 means the external_id is already bound to a different point.

post.summary: Create many measurements in one request (partial success)
post.description: Write up to 1000 readings in a single request. Each item is processed independently and idempotently (by external_id): the results array reports created / duplicate / error per item with its index, so one bad row never sinks the batch and re-sending the whole batch is safe. For nightly-sync volumes use a service token, which is exempt from the burst/sustained limits API-wide; human tokens are throttled normally.

post.summary: Create a measurement with file attachment
post.description: Record a new measurement with a file attachment. Send as multipart/form-data with a 'payload' JSON string field and a 'file' field. Honors external_id for idempotency, same as the JSON endpoint.

get.description: Offset paginated by default (limit/offset, includes total). Pass ?cursor= for keyset pagination over long timeframes — it skips the expensive COUNT and returns next_cursor instead of total. Filter either mode by created_from / created_to (ISO-8601).

post.summary: Upload a file to an existing measurement
post.description: Attach a file to an existing measurement. File kind is auto-detected from the filename and measurement point type.

post.summary: Submit an item response with photo attachments
Create a route item + response during execution (field-authored)
Assign a zone-only field item to an asset

post.description: Device reports it is online and optionally sends per-service health.
Bulk upload measurements identified by DeviceMapping UUID. The server resolves each mapping_uuid to the correct MeasurementPoint.

post.summary: Attach a file to a MaintNode measurement
post.description: Upload a binary file (e.g. .dr waveform) and attach it to an existing measurement. File kind is auto-detected from filename and measurement point type.

MeasurementBatchResultOut.description:
Per-item outcome for a batch write. ``status`` is one of created /
duplicate / error. ``duplicate`` means an idempotent hit (external_id was
already recorded) — the existing reading is returned unchanged.
MeasurementBatchResultOut.title: MeasurementBatchResultOut

FieldItemIn.description:
Create a RouteItem + ItemResponse in one call (field-authored survey item).

The item is zone-anchored (or route-level with ``zone_id=None``); the
technician triages it to a specific asset later via ``/triage``.
FieldItemIn.title: FieldItemIn
